definitions.stop_latency: protective-zone entry (separation <= 0.45 m) to all arm joints below 0.05 rad/s; only entries where the arm was still moving (>= 0.05 rad/s)
definitions.separation_at_stop: human-to-robot surface distance when the arm reached the stop threshold
definitions.pick_rate: objects placed in the bin / objects offered
definitions.why: largest non-compute attribution component of the missed jobs

realism.fast_conveyor: 0.4 m/s is the top of the spec's 0.1-0.4 m/s range; NPU floors are S8 steps; 45 C ambient is S5's range; 24 Gbit/s is an S7 step

provenance.behavior_source: scripted expert in hybrid mode; VLA compute modeled from its operator graph
